images: WSI level-zero pixels registered by slide MPP; real 0.425um WholeCell masks
evidence: 0.45 whole-cell B/T occupied-area support + 0.30 H&E hematoxylin density + 0.25 B/T nuclear-query density; each scaled by local seed/background medians
seed: Erosion by25um of the previous local region; background20–100um away from that region; same method for both candidates
support: Continuous score>=0.5 and local B/T fraction>=0.45; geodesic-connected aggregate with greatest seed overlap
regularization: 18um opening separates thin connections; 6um constrained restoration; 10um closing; enclosed lumens filled. Gaussian signed-distance regularization sigma6um changes the saved mask itself.
contour: Marching squares on the continuous signed-distance zero level, not on a binary raster; no point simplification, no hand-drawn contour
scope: Two local exploratory regions. Not trained TLS segmentation or pathology-validated boundaries. All cohort survival results retain their original masks.
